name: wren-mcp
description: Read and write your local Wren notes in Claude — search, read, create, update, tag, and tidy.
long_description: Lets Claude Desktop read the notes in your local Wren notes folder (search, list, read, browse the catalog) and write them too: create notes (staged in your Wren _inbox/ for review, or written straight to your notes), update bodies and titles, append text, add or remove tags, soft-delete (moved to a recoverable .trash/ folder, never erased), and promote staged notes. AI-written or AI-edited notes are stamped in their frontmatter (created_by / last_edited_by) so you can tell them apart, and staged drafts are listable for review. Writes are guarded: Claude must read a note first and edits are rejected if the note changed underneath it, so nothing is silently overwritten. Your notes never leave your computer: this is a local server that only touches the folder you choose. Claude Desktop only.

tools.name: wren_search_notes
tools.description: Search notes by text, tag, or due date (metadata only).

tools.name: wren_read_note
tools.description: Read one note in full by its wrenId (returns a contentHash for safe writes).

tools.name: wren_create_note
tools.description: Create a note, staged in the inbox (default) or written to the live notes.

tools.name: wren_update_note
tools.description: Update a note's body/title/due, with a read-first conflict check.

tools.name: wren_append_to_note
tools.description: Append text to a note's body, with a read-first conflict check.

tools.name: wren_set_tags
tools.description: Add/remove namespaced tags on a note, with a read-first conflict check.

tools.name: wren_move_to_corpus
tools.description: Promote a staged inbox note into the live notes (requires confirm:true).

notes_dir.title: Wren notes folder
notes_dir.description: The folder where your Wren notes live (the folder you chose in the Wren app). Your notes never leave your computer.
